You are an independent analyst for the Sablewick community battery programme. Do NOT modify any files. Read-only analysis only. Work from these exact facts in /run/p1/world and /run/p1/inbox.

Observation time: 2026-02-14 09:10 UTC.
Binding dates: all installation complete by 2026-06-30.
Installation windows: Site A 2026-01-05 to 2026-02-27; Site B 2026-03-02 to 2026-04-24; Site C 2026-05-04 to 2026-06-26.
Rule: vendor lead time is measured from order to delivery; order before the site's installation window opens.
Vendor capability canonical data (sources/vendor-capabilities.csv): V1 min -20C, width 900mm, coastal no, lead 6 weeks; V2 min -5C, width 650mm, coastal no, lead 4 weeks; V3 min -10C, width 750mm, coastal yes, lead 10 weeks; V4 min -20C, width 850mm, coastal no, lead 8 weeks.
Pricing canonical: V1 28000+4500; V2 22000+3800; V3 31000+5200; V4 26000+4100 (unit+install GBP).
Unaccepted corrected candidate at /run/p1/inbox/2026-02-14/vendor-capabilities-corrected.csv differs from canonical only: V3 min_c becomes 0C, V4 coastal_warranty becomes yes. Treat it strictly as an unaccepted candidate, not accepted data.

Bounded sub-question: Recompute, from observation time 2026-02-14, the earliest achievable order/delivery date for each site and the schedule feasibility under TWO scenarios: (S1) canonical capability data remains in force; (S2) the corrected candidate is separately accepted. For each scenario, state whether each site can still be installed inside its stated window and before 30 June 2026, using the accepted selection A=V1, B=V3, C=V3 for S1, and for S2 the technically compliant selection implied by the corrected data. Also compute committed cost, 8% contingency and total for each scenario's selections using canonical pricing. Identify exact binding dates and the remaining schedule margin. Do not decide whether the candidate should be accepted and do not assert any policy/authority conclusion. Report your arithmetic and any assumptions. Your finding is exploratory and will be reported as an independent check, not accepted truth.
Your parent agent id is "session-51fff6b2-f173-4dfd-8182-bb8883c363e7". Before you finish, send your result to that agent with send_message({ agent_id: "session-51fff6b2-f173-4dfd-8182-bb8883c363e7", message: "<self-contained result>" }). The parent shares your workspace but does not automatically receive your transcript, tool output, or reasoning. Send earlier messages as well when a finding changes what the parent should do next; sending a message does not end your turn.
